sequence_column.title: Sequence column
sequence_column.description: Column containing aligned BCR nucleotide sequences (gapped or ungapped).

clone_id_column.title: Clone ID column
clone_id_column.description: Column used to group sequences into clones.

germline_id_column.title: Germline/allele column
germline_id_column.description: Column storing V germline IDs or alleles that BrepPhylo will map to its germline database.

label_column.title: Label column
label_column.description: Optional human-readable label for tips; falls back to sequence order if empty.

class_column.title: Class column
class_column.description: Optional column used by BrepPhylo for per-class colouring and palette generation.

which_clones.title: Restrict to clone IDs
which_clones.description: Optional list of clone IDs to include, as a comma/space/semicolon-separated string (e.g. 'c1, c2 c3'). Empty means all clones.

ignore_clones.title: Ignore clone IDs
ignore_clones.description: Optional list of clone IDs to exclude, as a comma/space/semicolon-separated string. Applied after which_clones.

germline_set.title: Germline set
germline_set.description: Optional germline set identifier or path passed to BrepPhylo::cloneLineage (germlineSet). Leave blank for package defaults.

tree_type.title: Tree builder
tree_type.description: Tree construction method passed to treeConstruction$type ('simple', 'dnapars', or 'igphyml').

collapse_and_replace.title: Collapse identical sequences (dnapars)
collapse_and_replace.description: If true, collapse identical sequences before parsimony reconstruction and re-expand afterwards (tree_type = 'dnapars').

igphyml_accuracy.title: IgPhyML accuracy preset
igphyml_accuracy.description: Accuracy preset passed to IgPhyML (e.g. 'basic', 'high', 'extreme'); leave blank for the BrepPhylo default.

ig_stop_policy.title: IgPhyML stop/frame policy
ig_stop_policy.description: How to handle sequences with stop codons or out-of-frame lengths when tree_type = 'igphyml': drop sequences, fall back to dnapars, or error.

min_clone_size.title: Minimum clone size
min_clone_size.description: Discard clones with fewer sequences than this threshold before tree building.

species.title: Species
species.description: Species identifier for selecting BrepPhylo germline references.

algorithm.title: Alignment algorithm
algorithm.description: Multiple sequence aligner; default (model) is ClustalOmega.

gather_plots.title: Gather plots
gather_plots.description: Gather individual clone plots into a combined PDF where supported.

use_temp_dir.title: Use per-run temp dir
use_temp_dir.description: Let BrepPhylo stage intermediate files in a temp directory inside the container.

apply_filters.title: Apply sequence text filters
apply_filters.description: Enable sequence-level preprocessing on the sequence column (uppercase, gap policy, non-IUPAC policy).

uppercase.title: Uppercase sequences
uppercase.description: Convert all letters in the sequence column to uppercase before further processing.

gap_policy.title: Gap policy
gap_policy.description: How to treat gap characters ('-', '.', whitespace) in the sequence column when apply_filters = true.

noniupac_policy.title: Non-IUPAC policy
noniupac_policy.description: How to treat non-IUPAC nucleotides in the sequence column when apply_filters = true.

max_class_categories.title: Max class categories for colouring
max_class_categories.description: Maximum number of distinct class values allowed for colouring. If exceeded, class-based colouring is disabled and a warning is returned.
